flawless: I fought in the Cabal's pits for sport. You would not have lasted one bout.
Haste, fire and wings. You barely had time to see me arrive.
Not a scale out of place. The pit crowds would have howled for a better foe.
solid: You cut my wing. The pit dogs never managed that. I am almost proud of you.
Blood on my blades and fire in my throat. A good day.
close: Ha! You made a dragon sweat. Few pit fighters ever did.
My scales are cracked and my fire is low. That was a fight worth the roaring.
